$description: Where each token in src/tokens.ts came from. Keyed by leaf path (the path inside shared, themes.light|dark or profiles.web|desktop|mobile, so a colour in both themes and a size on every platform are one entry). source: the product's Tier 2 name (--fg-body); mobile:<path> for a token in the phone's tokens.ts; proposal; or unmapped. mobile: the phone's own token for the mobile profile or palette when it differs from source. The source of a profile leaf is the desktop's; the web profile is a proposal for every leaf. Drafted by apps/catalogue/scripts/tokens-map.mts and hand-checked; drift against the product is printed by tokens-map.mts --drift.

font.lineHeight.caption.note: the product has no per-step line height: its leading is unitless ratios (--leading-tight 1, -snug 1.2, -body 1.5, -relaxed 1.6); the phone has none either

font.lineHeight.display.note: the product has no per-step line height: its leading is unitless ratios (--leading-tight 1, -snug 1.2, -body 1.5, -relaxed 1.6); the phone has none either

font.size.h1.note: the phone's 28 is its large title; its fontSize scale has 24 and 30

font.lineHeight.h1.note: the product has no per-step line height: its leading is unitless ratios (--leading-tight 1, -snug 1.2, -body 1.5, -relaxed 1.6); the phone has none either

font.lineHeight.h2.note: the product has no per-step line height: its leading is unitless ratios (--leading-tight 1, -snug 1.2, -body 1.5, -relaxed 1.6); the phone has none either

font.lineHeight.h3.note: the product has no per-step line height: its leading is unitless ratios (--leading-tight 1, -snug 1.2, -body 1.5, -relaxed 1.6); the phone has none either

font.size.largeTitle.note: ours: a header's large title, such as a sheet's. The same 28 on every platform; text.h1 is 26 on web and desktop

font.lineHeight.lead.note: the product has no per-step line height: its leading is unitless ratios (--leading-tight 1, -snug 1.2, -body 1.5, -relaxed 1.6); the phone has none either

font.size.micro.note: ours: 11 on every platform, below --text-caption (12); the product has the 11 as a raw font size (--text-raw-11) and a --text-micro of 14 that is not this

font.lineHeight.title.note: the product has no per-step line height: its leading is unitless ratios (--leading-tight 1, -snug 1.2, -body 1.5, -relaxed 1.6); the phone has none either

textField.prefixOffsetX.note: ours: pull-in of a prefix against the text, -4 on web and desktop, -8 on the phone; the product has no text-field tokens

textField.tagPaddingX.note: ours: side padding of the tag beside a field's label

textField.trailingOffsetX.note: ours: pull-out of a trailing control onto the field's inner edge

thinkingIndicator.cellSize.note: ours: one lattice cell, 6 in the desktop app and ThoughtLine.tsx

thinkingIndicator.cellRadius.note: ours: a cell's corner, a quarter of the cell (1.5) on both apps

thinkingIndicator.markWidth.note: ours: the mark's column, 32 on the desktop, 30 on the phone (the avatar column less the head gap)

thinkingIndicator.maxWidth.note: ours: the indicator's widest, 480 in the desktop app

tooltip.kbdHeight.note: ours: height of the key cap shown inside a tooltip, smaller than the standalone Kbd's 20

tooltip.kbdFontSize.note: ours: font size of the key cap inside a tooltip

tooltip.maxWidth.note: ours: widest a tooltip grows before its text wraps

tooltip.paddingX.note: ours: side padding of a tooltip

tooltip.paddingY.note: ours: vertical padding of a tooltip

size.layout.topBar.note: ours: the window top bar (title bar, app menu bar, web top bar), 44 like the product's --breadcrumb-h strip. The product's --topbar-h is 68 and has no consumer (ADR-0177). Split from breadcrumb.h on 2026-11-03

size.layout.topBarSearchMax.note: ours: widest the search slot in the title bar and the web top bar grows

size.layout.topBarSearchMin.note: ours: narrowest the search slot shrinks to: 220 in the web top bar, 240 in the desktop title bar. The kits differ

updateBanner.bannerWidth.note: ours: width of the update banner on web

updateBanner.buttonSize.note: ours: side of the round icon button that opens the update

updateBanner.cardPaddingX.note: ours: side padding of the update card on desktop

updateBanner.cardPaddingY.note: ours: vertical padding of the update card on desktop, off the space scale to match the card's 40pt height

updateBanner.cardWidth.note: ours: width of the update card on desktop

updateBanner.dotInset.note: ours: how far in from the button's top right corner the status dot sits

updateBanner.versionTileSize.note: ours: side of the version tile in the phone's update banner

color.background.warning.soft.note: the phone's soft status fill is its tag background (our tag.warningBg), a different value from the desktop's

workspaceSwitcher.badgeOffsetX.note: ours: how far the unread badge sits past a workspace tile's right edge

workspaceSwitcher.badgeOffsetY.note: ours: how far the unread badge sits above a workspace tile

workspaceSwitcher.markerRadius.note: ours: radius of the marker's right corners

workspaceSwitcher.markerOffsetY.note: ours: how far down the rail item the active-workspace marker starts

workspaceSwitcher.markerWidth.note: ours: width of the active-workspace marker on the rail's edge

workspaceSwitcher.menuRowHeight.note: ours: minimum height of a workspace row in the menu: 64pt on the phone, 44 on web and desktop. The kits differ

workspaceSwitcher.menuWidth.note: ours: width of the workspace menu on web and desktop; the phone's fills the screen

workspaceSwitcher.tileRingWidth.note: ours: width of the ring around the current workspace's tile on the phone

workspaceSwitcher.tileRadius.note: ours: corner radius of a workspace tile. Not radius.card, which is 16 on the phone

zIndex.menu.note: no z-index scale in the product's tokens.json

zIndex.modal.note: no z-index scale in the product's tokens.json

zIndex.popover.note: no z-index scale in the product's tokens.json

zIndex.rail.note: no z-index scale in the product's tokens.json

zIndex.sticky.note: no z-index scale in the product's tokens.json

zIndex.toast.note: no z-index scale in the product's tokens.json

zIndex.tooltip.note: no z-index scale in the product's tokens.json
